author: Resonant Alpha
description: Persistent token and cost tracking across all agents. Listens for LLM output events and appends per-call usage entries (input tokens, output tokens, cache read/write, model, provider) to a JSONL ledger file for analysis and budgeting.

grantPresets.description: Enable token usage logging with workspace filesystem access for the JSONL ledger file.
grantPresets.label: Recommended usage tracking

name: Usage Tracker

surfaces.description: Background monitor showing cumulative token usage, per-model breakdowns, and recent usage entries.
surfaces.label: Usage Tracker Monitor

tools.description: Read the usage JSONL ledger and return aggregate token counts grouped by model and provider, with optional date range filtering.

groupBy.description: Grouping dimension: model, provider, or agent. Defaults to model.

since.description: ISO-8601 date to start aggregation from. Defaults to all time.

tools.name: usage_tracker.summary
